summary: Helped participants occur as zero-marked NPs (builders, uncle), l-series pronominal recipients, or omitted recoverable participants. The activity is commonly b-marked; no experiencer pattern is forced onto the helper/assisted relation.
Reciprocal ḥḏoḏe is an overt object of active help, including collective u+ʕamo with singular agreement. gmiʕawən in MAC Ishaq Material culture/61 supplies distinct Detransitive evidence.

Infectum-wa ranges from repeated labour and governance to a counterfactual protasis (Hors 1/85, already EL85). Unprefixed Infectum includes prospective/conditional and optative assistance; translated past tense alone cannot reclassify it.
m-less Imperativ ʕawalli and plural ʕAwenullan occur across MAC and Prym–Socin beside inherited mʕawən. n+l assimilation and 1sg mʕawannux are preserved, not normalized.

ʕewono/ʕEwono denotes the action of helping; faluṫa is a community labour institution defined by unpaid reciprocal work. This does not create a separate sense of help or a new light-verb construction under ʕwn.
